issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies addGuestStudents(int): void (no return value), but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) to return boolean. The template leaves the method unimplemented, so students following the UML/signature in the problem would expect a void method while the solution demonstrates a boolean return type. This mismatch can confuse students about the intended method signature and expected behavior (whether a success flag should be returned).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addGuestStudents(int) method signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution implementation to match the UML and problem description by returning void and only updating the guest student count, or (B) update the problem statement (UML) and template instructions to indicate addGuestStudents(int) returns a boolean (and document the meaning of the returned value). Ensure the template method signature matches the chosen contract so students implement the correct return type.
